scope: Static exact-build boundary and ABI review from saved capture/disassembly only; no process access, writes, hooks, install, or network test.

evidence.input_shape: RDX points to a join record whose count is read at +0x18 and whose member identifiers are qwords from +0x08; the bounded callback copies 48 bytes before calling this root.
evidence.owner_register: RCX is a host/owner candidate in the saved static map; caller ownership is not fully closed and must remain an explicit unresolved ABI item.

patch_boundary.safe_action: Require exact stolen-length disassembly and owner lifetime before detour. Do not patch the capacity gate with a normal entry detour.

required_abi: preserve r12/r13/r14/rbp/r9 and live stack locals
obtain sidecar capacity using the current owner and count in eax
set ecx=sidecar_capacity-eax and reproduce cmp ecx,r13d
branch to the original taken or fallthrough continuation
preserve return, exception, and unwind behavior
chain.patch_decision: A cmp/immediate edit is unsafe; this is a custom register-preserving continuation stub.

evidence.scan: 0x108c3d8..0x108c3e5 scans host+0x100 byte flags and compares loop index with 4

inferred_live_values.r9: host base candidate used by host+0x100 flag addressing
inferred_live_values.r8d: selected index value consumed by the write

required_abi: allocate 0..7 in sidecar while preserving native index publication
write the selected index before the original continuation observes the slot
preserve holes and reject duplicate generation
provide exact continuation and failure return for the full loop
chain.patch_decision: Mid-function loop contract and failure continuation are not fully recovered; a constant 4-to-8 edit is unsafe.

evidence.descriptor_shape: five fields: two 8-byte identifiers, two 4-byte integer fields including player index, one 4-byte status/boolean

required_abi: route all eight sidecar host records into the existing wrapper shape
preserve equal-local-peer direct 0xb90b20 branch and remote 0xbe4910 branch semantics
retain status and sender ordering across the asynchronous callback
chain.missing_edge: The saved capture does not close the runtime hash-to-receiver registration for 0x4804fcf4.

chain.role: five-field receiver wrapper into client append

evidence.callee_arg_shape: the fourth decoded dword is passed as the player-index argument

required_abi: resolve the runtime dispatcher binding before routing real callbacks
copy fields into sidecar storage before any native inline write
rollback sidecar reservation if decode or append fails
chain.missing_edge: The callback table pointer run narrows a candidate but does not prove hash-to-callback registration.

evidence.fifth_record_address: client+0x150, which is an adjacent live structure

required_abi: replace count-driven inline append with eight-slot sidecar routing
keep index DWORD full-width and preserve missing/sentinel behavior
adapt remove/reset and all owner-relative index readers together
chain.patch_decision: A fifth append without relocation overwrites client+0x150; increasing the count alone is unsafe.

evidence.comparison: 0x1086460 compares dword [rdx+r8+0x163ac] with 4 using unsigned jae at 0x1086469
evidence.fallback: 0x108624d writes a type-3 ring record and skips accepted creation

required_abi: permit only validated network indexes 0..7, including sentinel rejection
route index 4..7 to an equivalent resource creation path
preserve handle, FDC140, 608B60, roster binding, and cleanup contracts
chain.patch_decision: Changing jae threshold alone is insufficient because accepted code immediately touches other four-slot state.

evidence.host: peer, flags, four large records and four pending records are all inline or fixed-bound
evidence.client: remove swaps 0x20-byte records by count; reset clears 0x80 bytes at +0xd0

required_abi: preserve stable index holes and generation checks
release sidecar resources before native callback observes removal
adapt host migration and all callback reentry paths
chain.patch_decision: No complete production cleanup/lifetime hook set is established.

production_blockers: No verified runtime PlayFab/Party acceptance result for a fifth account.
No closed hash-to-receiver dispatcher binding for confirmed-peer event 0x4804fcf4.
No complete register/stack/unwind/continuation ABI for the host capacity and allocator mid-function sites.
No proven owner lifetime, reentrancy, rollback, migration, and cleanup contract for host/client sidecars.
No production player-creation callback/resource lifetime contract for network indexes 4..7.
No fifth-account same-mission test; all current bridge and sidecar tests are synthetic/offline.
allowed_next_step: Implement and review sidecar orchestration against these boundaries, then obtain explicit authorization for a staged fixed-build bridge test. Keep install/live readiness blocked until every production blocker has evidence.
